title: The IFCASL Corpus of French and German Non-native and Native Read Speech
why_promising: Primary bilingual French-German learner/native production corpus with about 100 speakers, word- and phone-level segmentation, and more than 50% of the corpus reported as manually corrected; directly relevant to L2 phonetics, duration, segmental realization, pitch range, tempo, pauses, and related production work.
open_question: Need a stable public corpus deposit containing the annotation/measurement files themselves and file-level redistribution terms. The paper verifies substantial manual correction but the current search surfaced only paper/project pages and audio samples, not a complete reusable token-level release.
